message.reasoning_content:
We need to identify crimes based on Chinese criminal law. Facts: organized gambling (非法赌博) using lottery, sports betting, acting as bookmaker, taking bets, etc. Crimes: "组织、领导、参加赌博活动罪" (组织赌博罪) or "开设赌场罪". Also "为赌博提供场所、设施、资金、技术支持" etc. The participants are individuals, but they are "坐庄揽注" i.e., acting as bookmaker. Under Chinese law, "开设赌场罪" (establishing a casino) applies to those who organize gambling for profit. Also "非法经营罪"? Not exactly. The main is "组织赌博罪" (组织、领导、参加赌博活动罪) under Article 303 of Criminal Law. Also "赌博罪" for participants, but the defendants are organizers. So the crimes: "开设赌场罪" (establishing a casino) and "组织赌博罪". However Chinese law distinguishes: "开设赌场罪" is for those who open a gambling venue; "组织赌博罪" is for those who organize gambling activities. The facts show they are "坐庄揽注" and "组织" participants. So "组织赌博罪" is appropriate. Also "非法吸收公众存款" not relevant. "诈骗" not. So answer: [组织赌博罪] maybe also "开设赌场罪". The question: "只写这部分事实直接支持的罪名". The facts show they organized gambling, took bets, used info as reference, etc. So the crime is "组织赌博罪". Could also be "开设赌场罪" if they set up a gambling operation. Usually Chinese law: "开设赌场罪" is for those who open a gambling place for profit. The description: "坐庄揽注" maybe not a physical place, but still gambling. I'd list both separated by ';' as they both could apply. But to be safe, list "组织赌博罪". Might also be "非法经营罪" if they used sports betting info? No.

Thus answer: [组织赌博罪]<eoa>
